episode.title: First Contact
episode.style: original cinematic tactical military science fiction animation

bible.visual_style: grounded original tactical science fiction, visible human faces in dialogue, layered fabric-and-armor operator gear, graphite BLACKSTAR palette with cyan/amber accents, practical lighting, realistic weight, no copied franchise designs
bible.camera: 35-50mm cinematic lenses, readable geography, motivated handheld during combat, smooth discovery moves, consistent 180-degree direction
bible.palette: graphite, steel blue, amber emergency light, cyan BLACKSTAR tech; rust-red reserved for RED VECTOR tease

characters.name: Commander Mara Voss
characters.look: warm brown skin, close-cropped dark hair, eyebrow scar, graphite command jacket with cyan stripe

characters.name: Jax Mercer
characters.look: dark brown skin, shaved head, boxed beard, heavy graphite exo-vest with amber tabs
characters.speech_rule: humor before action, quiet when serious

characters.name: Dr. Imani Vale
characters.look: medium-brown skin, curly hair tied high, slim technical armor with white diagnostics

characters.name: Rook
characters.look: light-brown skin, black undercut, cheek scar, light recon armor and sensor mast

bible.enemy: Veyr: original biomechanical soldiers with segmented ceramic armor and luminous masks; their commander adapts to tactics after observing them
bible.weapons: fictional cinematic electromagnetic, energy and field devices only; no real-world construction detail
role_readability: Rook detects threats before visual contact and takes alternate routes
Vale disables hostile devices and infrastructure
Jax opens hardened access and leads shock pushes
Voss controls lanes and prevents encirclement
Kestrel controls comms, doors, sensors and extraction
continuity_rules: faces, clothes, armor, abilities and weapons remain consistent across all segments
ability VFX use persistent color and sound motifs
weapons stay on the same side unless a handoff is shown
injury and dirt states only increase unless cleaned on screen
music, ambience and room tone crossfade across seams

shots: Kestrel cyan face in cockpit glass
segments.dialogue: KESTREL: Erebus Colony stopped transmitting eleven hours ago. VOSS: No distress beacon? KESTREL: None. VOSS: Then somebody wanted silence.
VOSS: Roles stay clean. Rook, eyes. Vale, kill their toys. Jax, open what will not open. JAX: Finally, a mission briefing I understand. ROOK: Ghostline live.

shots: Rook sensor overlay paints movement probabilities
segments.dialogue: ROOK: No bodies. No evacuation traffic. Ghostline has nothing above ground. VOSS: Then we follow what it does have.

segments.continuity_out: Rook kneeling over underground signal marker
shots: Rook kneels and rotates sensor puck
segments.dialogue: VALE: Grid is carrying full load. ROOK: Movement below us. Slow. Organized. VOSS: Mark the route. Nobody outruns Rook's picture.

shots: fictional breach pulse fractures alien-welded lock
Voss drops Aegis marker behind team
segments.dialogue: JAX: Knock. VALE: That was structurally unnecessary. JAX: Yet emotionally correct. VOSS: Aegis on the rear lane. If it lights red, nothing crosses it.

shots: faces lit by passing industrial lamps
Null Loom glyph locks onto unknown device
segments.dialogue: VALE: This cut is hours old. Not human tooling. JAX: Still want me opening it? VALE: I want you not touching it for five seconds.

shots: second hidden drone eye activates behind Vale
segments.dialogue: VALE: One device denied. VOSS: One? ROOK: Two. Behind her. VALE: Correcting.

shots: Rook calls threat before it fires
segments.dialogue: ROOK: Contact rear-left! JAX: Mine. VALE: Uplink is mine. KESTREL: Their network noticed both of you.

shots: Voss Aegis lane flashes cyan then red
first Veyr tests the lane and recoils
segments.dialogue: VOSS: They are probing the grid. Good. Let them learn the wrong door. ROOK: New route, right side. JAX: See? Recon earns his food.

shots: Voss signals fallback while Jax holds center
segments.dialogue: VOSS: Controlled withdrawal. Rook, find the flank. Vale, blind their support. JAX: And me? VOSS: Be obvious. JAX: My specialty.

shots: Rook uses upper service ledge to flank
Vale triggers industrial arm after disabling its lockout
Voss drops Aegis across side entrance
segments.dialogue: VALE: Their shots are steering us. VOSS: Then stop being steerable. Rook? ROOK: Side path is clear for twelve seconds. JAX: Luxury.
ROOK: Gravity is gone. KESTREL: Redirected, not gone. I have a route. VOSS: Put it on Rook. He leads.

shots: MANTA pulse opens reinforced maintenance bypass
segments.dialogue: JAX: Door is mine. VOSS: Open it and hold the hole. JAX: Two jobs. Premium rate.
VALE: They did not kill the colonists. They moved them. ROOK: Where? VALE: Somewhere this machine can reach. KESTREL: And it is preparing to do it again.

shots: commander looks directly at Voss after seeing Aegis markers
segments.dialogue: VOSS: This is reconnaissance. KESTREL: Energy growth is exponential. VEYR COMMANDER: Mara Voss. VOSS: Nobody told you my name.

shots: commander counters Voss's first lane denial
segments.dialogue: VOSS: Ninety seconds. Same roles. Jax, hold. Vale, deny. Rook, climb. Kestrel, extraction. JAX: And you? VOSS: I keep it looking at me.

shots: Voss duel with visible face through broken visor
Jax breach-pulses cover into new firing gap
Vale Null Loom desynchronizes first coupling
Rook follows Ghostline route up moving spine
segments.dialogue: VALE: First coupling down. ROOK: Twelve meters. JAX: You have six. VOSS: Change pattern. It learns repetition.
ROOK: Set! VALE: Run. KESTREL: I have selected the shortest route. VOSS: That is a wall. KESTREL: It was.

shots: Voss jumps last with open visor
segments.dialogue: JAX: Commander! VOSS: Go! KESTREL: Already doing so. VALE: Their network is collapsing. ROOK: Not all of it.

segments.continuity_out: cut to black after RED VECTOR tease
shots: hundreds of signals fill dark hemisphere
encrypted receiver elsewhere shows rust-red broken-arrow RED VECTOR insignia for a brief final sting
segments.dialogue: ROOK: We stopped it. KESTREL: Commander... that was not the only signal. VOSS: How many? KESTREL: I am still counting. UNKNOWN RED VECTOR VOICE: Copy the packet. BLACKSTAR found the door.
